_readme: In-narrative book mentions mined by actually fetching and reading the Project Gutenberg plain-text files for the 30-book batch. 4 of the 30 titles (To the Lighthouse, Orlando, As I Lay Dying, Point Counter Point) are NOT available on gutenberg.org (search returns no records) so no text was read for them and no mentions were extracted from them. Front-matter/editorial/translator-preface hits and idiom-style character comparisons (e.g. 'worthy of Tartuffe', 'a Don Quixote') were excluded as non-narrative or non-literal per project convention.
